messages:
kai: hey everyone  day 1 newbie here. quick checklist Qs so i don't ping the wrong people: who owns the canonical service-owner roster, who approves infra/repo access, and who should i page if a model-publish causes customer regressions? also where's a tiny cheat-sheet i can keep nearby?

sara: welcome kai! :wave: canonical owners live in the handbook service-ownership (pinned in #product). we also keep a one-page snapshot for new hires. i'll DM you that.

ton y: infra/repo approvals are routed through eng-infra. easiest is the access helper in #eng-infra. example to paste:
```/access-request repo:redwood-inference/model-serving role:developer reason:"onboarding - commit access"```
then tag @tony for review. paste the returned AR ID into your onboarding Jira.

amal: oncall/paging: if customers see wrong or stale completions, page eng-runtime first (they own model serving/version routing). if it looks infra-y (OOMs, autoscaler), eng-infra joins. if user-visible errors spike, include eng-sre + support@redwood.com. flow: triage in #eng-runtime -> oncall -> create incident if P1/P0.

kai: thanks! any tips to avoid waking folks during early experiments? don't want to spam pages while learning.

sara: use staging for noisy tests and add a short note to the runbook if you must test in prod. you can also toggle non-pager alerting for a dev window (see alerting-guidelines in the handbook). DM me and i'll help coordinate with oncall.

setup-bot: [auto] access request created: AR-9990 (repo:redwood-inference/model-serving) - reviewer: tony - status: pending.

kai: great  adding AR-9990 to my ONBOARD ticket. last one: who to cc for cross-team escalations (e.g., publish pipeline + infra)?

amal: for multi-team incidents, cc eng-runtime, eng-infra, eng-sre, and support@redwood.com. incident lead will coordinate. if it's a publish pipeline failure add eng-ml/modelops as well.

sara: i'll drop the one-pager in your DMs and add you to the new-hire owners snapshot. DM me any time if badge/kiosk stalls. :thumbsup:

kai: super helpful, thanks all! i'll follow up if any of the ARs hang.
